bio.text: Colby Watson is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in 2026, running against Republican Rep. Mark Harris.
WFAE's voter guide lists him as a small business owner and a Union County native who has not previously held elected office.
According to the guide, he says he built a business with his brother that grew to employ more than 50 people.
